changes.title: Privacy choices survive Android scene recreation
changes.text: UIMSD Privacy now restores the exact pending evidence-request list, evidence decision, community-vote offer list, in-progress vote ticks and account-request confirmation after Android recreates the statistics scene. Restoration repeats no answer, ballot or account action, queues nothing and sends nothing; saves, run history, scores, rules, combat, RNG and content are unchanged.

changes.title: Verify exact local Privacy state without side effects
changes.text: A core source guard and native API34 fixture cover every restored Privacy subflow. The device case uses an isolated synthetic evidence and vote history, retains exact labels and two selected vote ticks through repeated scene rebuilds, and requires unchanged fixture bytes, an empty submission queue and no created session. Preserve rejected TEST344 as the immediate compiled comparison; TEST341 remains the current owner-only published pair and TEST330 remains a verified fallback until all gates pass.

commentary: Preserve every compiled TEST344 history TSV and append exactly one reviewed record. TEST344 is the immediate previous compiled APK but remains rejected and unpublished after retained API36 Back and short-landscape failures; TEST341 is the current owner-only published pair and TEST330 remains a verified fallback. This is one intentional application candidate for bounded offline UIMSD Privacy restoration, not a verification-only rebuild. No public release, automatic tester distribution, physical-phone claim, online activation or billing change.
